outlook.discussion: 1. Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands (EP91): An area of low pressure located well east-southeast of the Hawaiian Islands is producing limited showers and thunderstorms this morning. Only a slight increase in shower and thunderstorm organization is needed for it to become a tropical depression during the next day or two while it moves slowly east-northeastward. Environmental conditions are expected to become less conducive for development late this week. Formation chance through 48 hours...high...90 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.
